Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Taco Bell Grilled Cheese Steak Burrito at Home!  I'm a former Taco Bell employee, and this is one of my favorite menu items! 🥩 STEAK 1 lb top sirloin, thinly sliced ½ tsp salt 1 tsp brown sugar ½ tsp beef bouillon ⅛ tsp cocoa powder ½ tsp onion powder ½ tsp garlic powder ¼ tsp paprika ½ tsp cornstarch Sauce: ½ cup water 1 tsp beef bouillon 1 tsp brown sugar ½ tsp onion powder ½ tsp garlic powder ⅛ tsp cocoa powder ½ tsp cornstarch Cut steak against the grain for tenderness. Toss with dry seasonings and sear in a little oil over medium-high heat. Whisk sauce ingredients together, pour over steak and simmer gently until cooked through and lightly thickened. Add water if needed. 🍚 SEASONED RICE 2 cups white rice 2 cups water 2 tbsp Knorr Tomato Chicken Bouillon 2 tbsp oil ¾ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder ½ tsp paprika Rinse rice until water runs mostly clear. Add everything to rice cooker, stir and use the white rice setting. Fluff before serving. Adjust water to your cooker's instructions. 🌶️ CHIPOTLE SAUCE 1 cup mayonnaise 1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo 1 tsp adobo sauce ½ tsp each chili powder, sugar, salt ¼ tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, paprika Blend until creamy. Refrigerate until needed.   🌯 ASSEMBLY Large flour tortillas Seasoned steak and rice Nacho cheese (I use frito's jalapeno cheddar) Chipotle sauce Tortilla strips Sour cream Shredded Mexican-blend cheese Warm tortilla so it's flexible. Layer rice, steak, nacho cheese, chipotle sauce, tortilla strips and sour cream. Fold sides in and roll tightly. Toast seam-side down in a skillet. Remove, sprinkle cheese into a nonstick skillet and place burrito on top, untoasted side down. Cook over medium-low until cheese melts and turns golden. Let cool slightly so the cheese sets on the tortilla. Is this easier than just spending $8 at Taco Bell? Absolutely not. 😂 But we order these often enough that I love knowing how to make them at home! Want a separate tutorial for the steak, rice or sauce? The viral Brothy rice bowls are sooo savory and cozy and delish!! Made mine with a few extra veg too. Such a great dairy free dinner! Curry Broth * 3 cloves garlic, minced * 1 shallot, finely chopped * 3 tbsp red curry paste * 1 can light coconut milk * 1 cup chicken or beef broth * 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * Oil, for cooking Ground Beef & Vegetables * 1 lb ground beef * 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * 1 zucchini, sliced * 2 cups chopped spinach * Oil, if needed Serving * 2 cups cooked rice * Garnishes: Squeeze of lime, Chili crisp, Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Heat a drizzle of oil in a saucepan. Add garlic and shallot and sauté until fragrant. Add red curry paste and toast for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. 2. Brown the ground beef in a skillet with 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce. Add sliced zucchini and cook until softened. Add chopped spinach and cook for a few more minutes until wilted. 3. Add rice to a bowl, top with the beef and vegetables, and pour the curry broth over everything. Garnish with lime, chili crisp, and sesame seeds.

This chicken recipe went viral for a reason… 🤤🍗 Almost 800K views later, and we’re STILL making it every Sunday! 😂 At this point, my family just knows what’s for dinner, and honestly, nobody’s complaining! It’s easy, packed with flavor, and turns out AMAZING every single time. Served over mashed potatoes with that delicious gravy?! SO GOOD! 🤌🏼 🍗 VIRAL CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! We love serving ours over mashed potatoes with roasted green beans and honey butter rolls! 🤎 SAVE this for your next Sunday dinner! I promise it’s one you’ll make again and again! All the credit goes to @Allyssainthekitchen for this AMAZING recipe! 🫶🏼 #ChickenThighRecipe #SundayDinner #EasyDinnerIdeas #ViralRecipes #FamilyDinner

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Chicken & Green Bean Stir Fry 🥢🥡 Crispy chicken, tender green beans, and a sweet and savory garlic sauce make this easy stir fry better than takeout! Ingredients: 1.5 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into thin strips 2 Tablespoons cornstarch 1/4 cup soy sauce 3 Tablespoons honey 2 Tablespoons rice vinegar 2 Tablespoons hoisin sauce 1 teaspoon ground ginger 1/4–1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes 2 teaspoons cornstarch 3 Tablespoons toasted sesame oil 1 pound frozen green beans 5–6 scallions, whites & greens separated 8 cloves garlic, finely minced How to Make: 1️⃣ In a medium bowl, toss the chicken with 2 Tablespoons of cornstarch until evenly coated. Set aside. 2️⃣ In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, ground ginger, red pepper flakes, and 2 teaspoons of cornstarch. Set aside. 3️⃣ Heat about half of the sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Working in 2–3 batches, cook the chicken undisturbed for a few minutes to brown, then flip and cook until golden and cooked through, about 5–7 minutes per batch. Remove and set aside, adding more oil as needed. 4️⃣ Reduce the heat to low and add the remaining sesame oil. Add the minced garlic and white parts of the scallions. Sauté for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. 5️⃣ Add the frozen green beans and sauté for 6–8 minutes until tender, increasing the heat to medium if needed. 6️⃣ Return the chicken to the skillet and pour in the prepared sauce. Stir to coat everything evenly and cook for 2–3 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add a splash of water or chicken broth if needed. Garnish with the green parts of the scallions and serve over rice!  📌Save this for an easy, better-than-takeout weeknight dinner! 🍚❤️ #chickenstirfry #greenbeans #easychickenrecipes #weeknightdinner #biteswithbri

Making that viral high-protein crockpot marry me chicken, but with a hormone-supportive upgrade. 🍲✨ When you’re navigating PCOS and prepping your body to conceive, keeping blood sugar steady and getting in nutrient-dense protein is everything. Swapping in chicken thighs gives you extra iron, zinc, and healthy fats, while bone broth brings in glycine and gut-supporting amino acids for that uterine lining.  I left out the red pepper flakes so Mila could eat dinner right along with us, and divided the rest into 8 meal prep containers for easy grab-and-go lunches. 🤍 Ingredients (Makes 8 servings):** • 2.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs • 1 cup organic chicken bone broth • 1 small onion, diced • 4 tsp minced garlic • 1 cup sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped • 1 tbsp paprika • 1 tbsp garlic powder • 1.5 tbsp Italian seasoning • Salt & black pepper, to taste • 1 tsp red pepper flakes (optional — omit for toddlers!) High-Protein Cream Sauce: • 1 cup 2% cottage cheese (200g) • 1 cup 0% plain Greek yogurt (240g) • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 2–4 tbsp warm bone broth from the crockpot Stir-ins: • 2 cups freshly grated parmesan (200g) • 2–3 cups fresh baby spinach • 2.5 cups dry jasmine rice (cooked) Instructions: Add chicken thighs, bone broth, onion, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, and seasonings (plus red pepper flakes if using) to the crockpot. Cook on LOW for 6 hours (or HIGH for 3–4 hours). Shred the chicken directly in the pot. Blend the sauce ingredients with a splash of the warm broth until completely smooth, then pour into the crockpot. Stir in parmesan and baby spinach until melted and wilted. Fold in cooked jasmine rice, stir until creamy, and divide into 8 containers! Macros per serving (1 of 8): • Calories: ~560 kcal • Protein: 48g • Carbs: 56g • Fat: 16g Save this for your next Sunday reset!
